_comment: Template only. Copy to config.json at this pipeline's root and paste in the REAL Google service-account key - never commit the real file (it is gitignored). core/config.py loads this whole file and exports it as GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, so it must be a standard Google service-account JSON shape, with one extra app_config block the pipeline reads for batch sizes and worker counts.

app_config._comment: Each entry is {default, max}; core/config.py's app_setting() resolves an explicit argument, else the env var of the same name (upper-cased), else default, and clamps to max. No app_config name is read by this pipeline's scripts yet - this block is here for the shape only. Add real entries (e.g. image batch sizes, worker counts) as the image-generation steps are wired in.
